name: XINHWA
recent: XINHWA 于 2026 年 8 月 28 日召开第 13 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获股东通过。公司同日发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告。10 月 9 日及 9 月 9 日另有「其他」类公告，但未提供内文。
notable: 第 13 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 8 月 28 日举行，所有普通决议案获股东通过。

ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: XINHWA held its 13th Annual General Meeting on 28 August 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were approved by shareholders. The company also released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on the same day. Two 'Others' announcements were made on 9 October and 9 September, but no details were provided.
notable_en: The 13th Annual General Meeting was held on 28 August 2026, and all ordinary resolutions were approved by shareholders.
